narr: Severe thunderstorms developed during the evening of the 14th with gusty winds in excess of 60 mph. Additionally, heavy rainfall resulted in street flooding for portions of Kimball.
ev: Significant runoff and street flooding observed near Kimball. Kimball Airport AWOS station (KIBM) measured 1.26 inches of rainfall in less than 90 minutes.
lsr: SIGNIFICANT RUNOFF AND STREET FLOODING OBSERVED.
